utterances.text: Oh, Crisco is just fat lard? I thought it was something more mysterious! But hey, if it helps make our red velvet cake moist and delicious, I'm all for it! Let's keep this baking adventure going, Grandma!

utterances.text: It is not 'lard.' You are really struggling to grasp simple concepts today. Just keep the bowl steady.
